flags.why: The common verb meaning “to exaggerate” is missing, as recorded in [Wiktionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/cường_điệu).
flags.fix: verb | to exaggerate; to overstate — Đừng cường điệu vấn đề. = Don't exaggerate the problem.

flags.why: The common meaning “nylon thread or fishing line” is missing, as recorded in [Rung's dictionary](https://v2.rung.vn/dict/vn_vn/Cước).
flags.fix: noun | nylon thread; nylon fishing line — Tôi mua một cuộn cước để câu cá. = I bought a spool of nylon fishing line.
